insights.title: You're short on sleep
insights.detail: Averaging 6h 43m a night this week, average score 79. That's about 5h 30m below a 7h30 target. An earlier night or two would help recovery.

insights.title: Stress is higher this week
insights.detail: Average stress 31 vs 24 the week before. High all-day stress eats into recovery too.

insights.title: Your long run is a big share of your week
insights.detail: Longest run in the last 2 weeks was 19.4 km. Keeping your long run under about 35–40% of your weekly distance lowers injury risk.

insights.title: Resting heart rate is down
insights.detail: 50 bpm over the last 3 days vs your usual 52: a sign of good recovery or improving fitness.

insights.title: Training load is steady
insights.detail: 5h 07m of training across 4 day(s) in the last 7 days, vs an average of 6h 10m a week over the 3 weeks before.

insights.title: 78% of your running is easy
insights.detail: That's the 80/20 balance most coaches recommend: lots of easy running builds the base, the hard 20% builds speed.

insights.title: Aerobic fitness is improving
insights.detail: Your recent runs cover 6% more distance per heartbeat than earlier ones: you're running faster at the same effort.

insights.title: VO2 max up 0.7
insights.detail: Now 51.4, up about 0.7 since 2026-01-01. Your aerobic engine is getting bigger.

insights.title: Your longest training block this year
insights.detail: This block started the week of 2026-07-13 and is in week 13. Since 2026-01-01, your earlier blocks lasted 5, 6, 8 weeks (average 6), each followed by 2+ quiet weeks. 1 of 3 ended within a few weeks of a jump of 30%+ in weekly distance; keeping increases around 10% a week may help this one last.

insights.title: Fitness vs June: about level with
insights.detail: Best heat-adjusted 5K-equivalent effort in the last 6 weeks: 21:59, vs 21:52 in June (+0.5%). At the same heart rate you cover 2% more distance than in June. This compares your best efforts, so it's only fair if you've run something hard recently.

insights.title: Little heart-rate drift on long runs
insights.detail: Average drift 2.3% over 5 long runs: your aerobic base holds up for the distance.

insights.title: HRV is stable
insights.detail: 7-day average 65 ms, in line with your baseline of 64 ms.

insights.title: 9.6 km run this week
insights.detail: Your last 4 weeks averaged 41.3 km. A sensible target for a full week is about 45 km (no more than ~10% above your average).

insights.title: 2.6 to reach 'Superior'
insights.detail: Your VO2 max of 51.4 rates 'Excellent' for your age and sex; 'Superior' starts at 54.0.

insights.title: Paces are heat-adjusted
insights.detail: Warm months (Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep) are corrected using temperature and dew point at the time of each run, so they compare fairly with cool ones.
